accounting.historical_metadata_scope: The retained plan review inspects historical native archive/trace metadata and pinned coder source only; historical sizes are neither new measurements nor score credit.
accounting.q16_scope: Synthetic replay parent probabilities are explicit uncompressed external input, bound per fixture; source, dictionary and options remain additional dependencies.

causality_and_bounds: The modeled mode byte 7 is coded but not interpreted as an uppercase control.
Raw fields start only after an event whose final raw byte is equals; learned donor fields end only when the delimiter is the first raw byte of an event.
Donor entry capitalization state must match; zero-emission controls inside the value are retained as modeled bytes.
Donors commit only after completed valid flat invocations; future suffixes, duplicate keys and nesting cannot retroactively change prefix predictions.
FIFO128, raw value/name/key/field/invocation caps and modeled donor cap256 remain bounded.
The exact donor/parent posterior floors once and clamps Q16; parent mass updates with the unmixed parent truth probability; mismatch kills the donor.
Canonical native re-encoding plus raw length/hash enforces finite decoder acceptance, including native zero extension.
Every modeled-byte state chain and final adapter/mixture state matches within each encode/decode/repeat arm.
